setup.title: Set up recording
setup.intro: In {{count}} short steps the app measures your microphone and sets the microphone volume and voice threshold to match.
setup.introSilent: While it runs, the others cannot hear you.
setup.introFiltered: Headphone mode is off. The browser then adjusts the volume on its own, so the measurement is only approximate.
setup.speakers: A few quiet tones are coming up. Stay quiet.
setup.typing: Now type and click as usual, like you would while gaming.
setup.speech: Read the sentence aloud at your normal volume, twice if you like:
setup.sentence: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, then takes a long nap in the warm afternoon sun.
setup.levels: Background {{noise}} dB · Typing {{typing}} dB · Voice {{speech}} dB
setup.noSpeech: I could hardly hear you. Check that the right microphone is selected and try again.

warning.speakers: Your microphone picks up your speakers. Turn headphone mode off, otherwise the others hear themselves.
warning.tooQuiet: Your microphone delivers very little level; even the highest volume is not enough. Most likely a slider somewhere is below maximum: in Windows or in your headset's software (e.g. SteelSeries GG, Logitech G Hub). Turn it up and measure again.
warning.clipping: Your microphone already clips before it gets here. Turn the level down in Windows or in your headset's software and measure again.
warning.typingAudible: Typing is almost as loud as your voice. The threshold only holds back the noise; keystrokes still get through. The mute key helps.
warning.noisy: The background is too loud for a voice threshold, so it stays off. Without headphone mode the browser filters the noise.

setup.tryIt: Talk to try it out. Whatever stays grey is below the threshold and is not sent.
setup.lobbyHint: First time here? Take a moment to set up your microphone, so you sound right from the start.
setup.offerAgain: New microphone or mode: set up recording again?
setup.requested: {{name}} asks you to set up your recording.
